biggest_catch: It's three stacked hurdles: the full $300 requires keeping $5,000 parked in a new savings account on day 90 — most people will realistically earn $50–$150.
catches: Expires 12/31/2026; provide offer code PK2 at account opening.
First $50: have the debit card issued and activated AND enroll in e-statements within 90 days.
Additional $100: first tier plus two or more direct deposits totaling at least $500 within 90 days.
Additional $150: first tier plus open a Money Builder Savings account with a $1,000 opening deposit and a $5,000 balance on the 90th calendar day.

On the 90th calendar day the account must be active, have a positive balance, an active debit card, and be enrolled in e-statements; bonuses credited within 10 calendar days after the day-90 review (by day 100).
New personal checking only: no current personal checking, none opened in the prior 12 months, and no checking bonus received in the prior 24 months.
$50 minimum to open checking ($5,000 for Premier Plus); a $50 fee applies if the account is closed within 180 days.

steps: Open a new personal checking account at the official promo page https://www.oldsecond.com/personal-banking/checking-300-em/ by 12/31/2026, providing offer code PK2 ($50 minimum to open; $5,000 for Premier Plus).
Within 90 days, have the debit card issued and activated and enroll in e-statements — this earns the first $50.
Within 90 days, receive two or more direct deposits totaling at least $500 — this adds $100.
Open a Money Builder Savings account with a $1,000 opening deposit and keep a $5,000 balance on the 90th calendar day — this adds $150.
Keep the checking account active with a positive balance, active debit card, and e-statements on the 90th day; bonuses are credited within 10 calendar days after the day-90 review (by day 100).
Do not close the account within 180 days — a $50 closure fee applies.
